verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a first-party REST API with a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec and Swagger UI, bearer keys shared with the CLI, SDKs, a Files API, and an agent-operable CLI. That covers a broad programmatic surface, but nothing states the API matches the UI feature for feature. Some flows are documented only through the UI: creating a Computers-scoped key in Settings, installing the GitHub App via Settings, and customizing templates from the agent page. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that UI-documented actions (scoped key creation, GitHub integration, template customization) are exposed via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
